All runs use the baseline configuration (Section~\ref{sec:workload}). Calls is the number of steady-state calls. With more than one call, the steady-state call is given as a mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation. Script gives the commit of the benchmark script. For the TPU, the Session column gives the time of the commit that holds the TPU result. A dash marks the August first calls on the T4 and on the CPU runtime. These first calls ran with the profiler. The TPU has no run without the profiler, so the table shows its first call. \dag{} This value probably includes the profiler teardown (Section~\ref{sec:res-first}). Single times keep the decimals that the scripts round to, including trailing zeros.
